snippet.title: The Last Gas Station | Out Now
snippet.description:
Buy now on Steam: https://s.team/a/3690030
Buy now on GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/the_last_gas_station
Buy now on EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-last-gas-station-8bb3a7

In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

Follow The Last Gas Station on X: https://x.com/playTLGS
Join our Discord server: : https://discord.gg/alawar
